scientific_integrity: The quantitative range bound and infinite witnesses are proved by a cyclic permutation argument. Classical weighted Sylvester sums already allow histogram recovery; finite tests are supporting reproducibility only.
scientific_limitations: The upper bound is proved sharp for moduli congruent to 0 or 3 modulo 4; for moduli congruent to 1 or 2 modulo 4, the exhibited lower bound differs by one. Requires both generators to be coprime to the modulus. An earlier equivalent quantitative formulation cannot be excluded.
title: Uniform near-quarter-modulus balance for two-generator numerical-semigroup gaps
